DIRECTION_AND_REGIME_SPEC.json.clock: Completed H1 CLOSE; advance D1,H4,H1,M15 at equal cutoff in that order; no incomplete bars.
DIRECTION_AND_REGIME_SPEC.json.uncertain: Missing/invalid active CONF leg, dual opposing CONF at same known_at, or incomplete/gapped required prefix => UNCERTAIN.
DIRECTION_AND_REGIME_SPEC.json.range: Active correction-to-impulse-end fixed range, completed EQ contact and inside CLOSE, latest CLOSE strictly inside boundaries, no later CONF superseding range. CLOSE at or outside either boundary retires range permanently; wick alone does not. Re-entry inside cannot reactivate a retired range.
DIRECTION_AND_REGIME_SPEC.json.trend: Current and immediately previous confirmed legs same sign, both protected origin and endpoint strictly advance in that sign. Completed CLOSE strictly beyond protected origin invalidates (LONG below/SHORT above); equality or wick alone does not. Two legs is a machine structure convention, not a fitted lookback.
DIRECTION_AND_REGIME_SPEC.json.transition: Valid active last CONF exists; neither RANGE nor strict two-leg TREND holds. Label its last direction; no predictive future label.
DIRECTION_AND_REGIME_SPEC.json.H4_range: H1 current leg and M15 confirmation match proposed direction; formation/retest intersects correct fixed H4 boundary. H4 RANGE takes priority over D1 trend, which is still recorded and must be valid.
DIRECTION_AND_REGIME_SPEC.json.trend_admission: If H4 and D1 are the same TREND_UP or TREND_DOWN, only that direction may enter with H1/M15 matching. Opposite candidate WAIT_H4_D1_TREND_DIRECTION; cannot fall through to transition via a POI. No directional exemption.
DIRECTION_AND_REGIME_SPEC.json.transition_admission: Only non-RANGE, non-aligned-trend combinations (opposite H4/D1 trends, trend+transition, or two transitions) use transition-origin POI gate: H1 leg/M15 match candidate; same-direction unconsumed confirmed H4/D1 POI intersects formation, known by formation OPEN. Candidate may oppose one HTF direction under this explicit machine convention. Otherwise WAIT.

RISK_NORMALIZATION_SPEC.json.prices: Decimal positive quote/base; zero-origin verified tick lattice; reject NaN/Infinity.
RISK_NORMALIZATION_SPEC.json.structural_boundary: Immutable branch extreme; SFP adds outward SMA14 true range including completed pattern bar and preceding CLOSE. 14 is inherited machine normalization, not source-mandated or re-tuned.
RISK_NORMALIZATION_SPEC.json.ATR: TR=max(H-L,abs(H-prev_close),abs(L-prev_close)); arithmetic mean exactly14 contiguous native-TF TRs ending exactly at pattern_end<=decision. Store immutable ATR at formation; later completed bars cannot drift it. Missing pattern bar/previous close/history => WAIT; no additional ATR risk floor.
RISK_NORMALIZATION_SPEC.json.rounding: LONG entry=floor(raw/t)*t, SHORT entry=ceil(raw/t)*t, still inside POI. Stop first grid price strictly outside immutable boundary, once only; no epsilon. Target first grid price strictly inside nearest FTA, never farther.
RISK_NORMALIZATION_SPEC.json.tick_requirement: symbol + USDT_LINEAR_PERPETUAL contract + literal verified=true + source/effective proof publication known_at <= decision + effective_from <= decision < effective_until; no overlaps; unknown/changed epoch WAIT. Future adapter must independently hash archived source bytes against source_sha256 and prove interval coverage/publication provenance; the pure core only validates schema/digest syntax, not evidence authenticity.
RISK_NORMALIZATION_SPEC.json.cash_stop_unit: K=d*(F-S)+C(F,S), recomputed at modeled actual fill; strictly positive
RISK_NORMALIZATION_SPEC.json.non_gap_stop_identity: Net_cash_R(S)=-1 exactly; stop gaps can exceed -1
RISK_NORMALIZATION_SPEC.json.minimum_risk: Verified positive tick separation and positive cost-inclusive K; no fitted min ATR/R/percentage hurdle. This normalizes arithmetic, not execution realism or positive expectancy.

ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.expiry_provenance: Inherited16H1pending/1H1order machine convention; no outcome tuning
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.fill_price_policy: CONSERVATIVE_LIMIT_PRICE_NO_OPEN_IMPROVEMENT: F=rounded E for any modeled limit touch. Retain actual modeled fill field; economics recheck uses F.
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.before_fill: Activate only bar OPEN>=decision; expire before OPEN>=expires. OPEN at/beyond stop/target invalidates before testing entry.
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.target_inventory: All completed contextual unconsumed opposing OB/STB/FVG on H1/H4/D1, unswept profit-side strict-swing pools, plus range far-boundary cap. Entry inside opposite POI rejects. Do not use a success score.
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.target_priority: Nearest signed forward raw distance, then canonical ID; retain coincident IDs. Round inward only after selecting nearest; collapsed/unprofitable target rejects without trying farther objects.
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.economics: M=d*(T-E)>C(E,T) strict; edge_cost_ratio=M/C(E,T)>1 is algebraic model-feasibility, not signal edge or calibrated margin.
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.adverse_liquidity: Inherited contextual internal adverse pool lying beyond structural stop rejects; mirrored completion is MACHINE_RULE_PRE_OUTCOME, not source-proven SHORT algorithm.
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.entry_bar_ambiguity: Any wick-only fill plus stop OR target touch => WAIT_INTRABAR_ORDER. OPEN fill: dual touch WAIT; single stop/target touch has interval bounds. No within-bar continuity assumption.
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.postfill: OPEN stop/target gaps execute before wick tests; dual wick touch WAIT; otherwise single touch interval. SFP body invalidation only native completed close, after wick processing.
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.metadata_change: Missing/changed active epoch before an order event => WAIT_HISTORICAL_TICK_METADATA, no new fill or inferred amendment; existing exposure flagged censored/unknown, never invented flat exit.
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.time_evidence: OPEN occurrences [start,start]; wick occurrences [start,end]; observations at completed end. Exit bounds independent of fill observation. Holding duration interval [max(0,exit_low-fill_high),exit_high-fill_low], never realized zero from observation equality.
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.unresolved: Keep entry information but exit/PnL/WIN/LOSS unknown; no imputed zeros. EOF order/open censoring distinct.
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.identity: physical is intentionally the directional bucket (symbol,formation_at,direction): same-time same-direction native formations share a bucket with fixed sibling/TF/ID priority; opposite directions have separate buckets. POI separately reserved at order emission. First eligible OHLC contact consumes at bar.end, occurrence bounds [start,end] or [start,start] if OPEN inside zone; never timestamp wick contact at OPEN. No old bucket/POI retry after loss/expiry/gap; later independent formation/CONF required.
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.bar_coverage: Adapter must advance every contiguous aligned900second bar from decision through active lifetime; last_observed_end is explicit. Missing interior bar=>WAIT_DATA_GAP; EOF/expiry never imply unfilled when coverage is incomplete.
ENTRY_TARGET_EXECUTION_SPEC.json.fill_assumptions: TOUCH_IMPLIES_FULL_LIMIT_FILL_AT_E and target touch full modeled exit; wick stop MODELED_STOP_TRIGGER_PLUS_SLIPPAGE, not observed exact fill. Grid proof alone does not prove queue, spread, latency, tick order, partial fill, or within-bar gap behavior. No within-bar continuity assumption establishes ordering; modeled trigger prices still need declared execution assumptions.

adapter_input_contract.formation: symbol/branch/direction/nativeTF60or240/formation_at/native bar OHLC+open/end/geometry IDs; raw geometry and reaction/refinement known_at<=decision; M15 alone cannot originate idea. SFP original_pattern_extreme maps to order.stop_anchor for body invalidation; distinct raw_stop_boundary=original_pattern_extreme plus/minus immutable pattern-end ATR then one outward tick for protective stop. Never pass the buffered boundary as body stop_anchor
adapter_input_contract.state: Every active leg current/previous ids, protected origin, endpoint, direction, known_at/end_swing_at; retired/body-broken leg flags; range fixed boundaries, context_id, EQ reaction and invalidation timestamps. Completed simultaneous TF changes visible at same H1 cutoff
adapter_input_contract.POI: id,tf,kind,direction,low/high,born_at,origin_bos_id,origin_CONF_known_at,contextual_at_birth,consumed_at/first_touch_bounds. Eligibility starts at first bar OPEN after origin CONF and matching active native context. Native first touch consumes even absent order
adapter_input_contract.FTA_eligibility: Decision-time complete H1/H4/D1 inventory: unswept HIGH pools forward LONG/LOW forward SHORT plus confirmed-contextual unconsumed opposite OB/STB/FVG proximal edges. Zone enclosing entry rejects; known_at<=decision. Range far boundary additional cap. Adapter must attach id/kind/tf/known_at/price, optional zone_low/high; preserve all nearest-price IDs and auditable inventory digest
adapter_input_contract.adverse_pool: From same complete inventory: internal to active H1 impulse, wrong-side liquidity beyond structural stop (LOW below stop for LONG, HIGH above stop for SHORT) => inherited mirrored adverse rejection; no source-proven SHORT claim
adapter_input_contract.adapter_status: Required full historical raw-event/state/inventory adapter is absent in this gate; pure core only checks supplied causal contract fields, not completeness of historical discovery. Missing mandatory geometry/eligibility evidence WAIT, never assume source-valid

contracts.SFP: Completed H1/H4 strict-swing raid/reclaim; next native OPEN reclaimed, usable only at its CLOSE; later M15 BOS/CONF; new origin-bound OB/FVG wholly inside pattern; proximal edge; pattern extreme±causal ATR14; native body invalidation exit.
contracts.OB: Raw raid/opposing candle/full engulf; later reaction; M15 BOS/CONF; new origin-bound OB/FVG inside raw OB; proximal edge; raw full extreme boundary.
contracts.BREAKER: Contextual-at-birth OB; later opposite body break beyond full extreme; M15 opposite BOS/CONF with no intervening reverse BOS; body-zone retest; parent-birth-through-break extreme boundary.
contracts.STB: Raw manipulation raid/engulf; later matching M15 BOS/CONF; manipulation body midpoint; full manipulation extreme boundary.
contracts.RANGE: Confirmed impulse plus interior correction; EQ contact/inside CLOSE; first deviation/reclaim then later boundary contact/inside CLOSE; M15 BOS/CONF; boundary entry; deviation extreme; far-boundary FTA cap.

SETUP_FAMILY_SPEC.json.formation_refinement_inheritance: Frozen M2 raw geometry/BOS/CONF/first-test selectors except explicit M3 overrides; no source-valid equivalence
SETUP_FAMILY_SPEC.json.shared_smoothness: No opposite M15 BOS between reaction and selected CONF; qualitative smoothness is a machine convention.
SETUP_FAMILY_SPEC.json.refinement_priority: OB before FVG; latest causal birth then canonical ID; formation/zone IDs and rejected siblings retained
SETUP_FAMILY_SPEC.json.range_parent_mapping: Use range on native setup TF. If global H4 RANGE governs admission, local formation must intersect its corresponding boundary; do not silently replace native source range geometry.
SETUP_FAMILY_SPEC.json.exits: Full nearest rounded FTA, all families; Range optional20% breakout is unresolved source choice, represented by full same-zone machine exit. No partial ladder or BE, no fixed percentages; Original canonical exits untouched.

robustness.partition_boundary: Exclude decisions or observation intervals crossing partition boundaries; censored/unresolved shown separately, not assigned zero

prospective_OOS.start_rule: Provisional plan only: first UTC D1 OPEN strictly after MAX(complete implementation pre-outcome freeze commit committer timestamp, append-only OOS registration commit committer timestamp). This contract-core design freeze alone cannot start the OOS clock. Register complete code/spec/data/protocol hashes and resolved start/end before first observation; missed preregistration/embargo => STOP, no post-outcome window shift
prospective_OOS.window_reason: Fixed four-season calendar evaluation commitment before outcomes, not an entry parameter
prospective_OOS.acquisition: Public completed M15 bars; derive contiguous UTC H1/H4/D1; no privateAPI/orders; metadata epoch announcements archived with publication known_at
prospective_OOS.embargo: Before locked end, no candidate signals, positions, trade labels or equity read, including inference from raw prices. Raw access only logged integrity-only script/role with no strategy-state access: hash/continuity/metadata checks. No interim optimization, early stopping, extension or relabeling after outcome
prospective_OOS.warmup: Exactly365 days pre-start completed bars for state warmup; no pre-start orders/outcomes. Prefix-only state reset/reservation ledger at OOS start
prospective_OOS.warmup_current_state: UNAVAILABLE_CONTIGUOUS: local Bybit public ends2025-12-05, native starts2026-01-25 and ends2026-09-22. Public gap filling needs independent evidence before registration; no interpolation/pretended ready prefix
prospective_OOS.training_leakage: No overlapping underlying OOS candles in development; hashes/copies/content periods checked; no carried development order or position
prospective_OOS.missing_data: No interpolation; gaps/instrument/metadata ambiguity => WAIT and unqualified-OOS report; do not shift window post hoc

validation.qualification: After separate authorization: fixed-spec development financial run, robustness, then locked untouched OOS; positive net ex-funding/PF>1 across declared model and stress reported, dependence-aware uncertainty and concentration disclosed. No production on reused TEST or subgroup alone; funding/actual execution evidence required for exchange-realism claim.
